from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashReport(BaseModel):
    """A single record of cash balance extracted from one company's financial statement."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the filing belongs to")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The specific label used for the cash line item in the document (e.g., 'Cash and cash equivalents', 'Cash')")
    value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the cash balance as reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the reported value (e.g., 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars')")
    reporting_period_end: str | None = Field(description="The date as of which the balance was reported")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_reports: list[CompanyCashReport]
